name: Emily Trinkaus
reason: Conspiracy-adjacent content on her own site (embodiedaquarian.com): her about page describes co-hosting a 'truth and freedom' astrology summit of astrologers who 'questioned the mainstream narrative of the past few years', and her podcast page features Dawn Lester on 'what really makes us ill' (germ-theory denial / anti-vaccine author), Eric Francis Coppolino and Sol Luckman on 'transcending the Matrix'. Skipped under the no-conspiracy rule (owner, 5 Nov 2026); otherwise she would have qualified (readings $285, classes, mentorship). For the owner to review if this reading is too strict.
